title: {model} module firmware
intro: Choose the .ota file from the module's maker. The hub writes it to the module's free memory half and switches the module to it — about 2 minutes over Wi-Fi. Metering keeps going.
badExt: An .ota file is needed — the module's maker publishes it.
badSize: The file is {got} bytes, the module expects exactly {want}. It is not for this module.
before: While switching, the module is off the bus for 10–15 seconds — that is expected. If the new firmware doesn't start, the module returns to the old one by itself.
busy: The hub is already updating a module. Wait for it to finish.
state_writing: Writing the firmware to the module
state_activating: Switching the module to the new firmware
whileWriting: Metering goes on as usual. You can close this window — the update continues.
whileActivating: The module is restarting and is briefly off the bus.
noAnswer: The hub didn't answer the progress request — retrying.
done: The module runs the new firmware: {before} → {after}.
error: The module stayed on its previous firmware. Reason: {why}.
manifestEmpty: no bank or board in it
noManifest: Without the .manifest the hub checks the board only after writing the whole image (~2 min). If it came with the .ota, add it.
wrongBank: The image is built for bank {got}, the free one is {want}. An image for {want} is needed — ask the maker.
wrongBoard: The image is for board {got}, the module is {want}. This file is not for this module.
wrongFile: The manifest describes {want}, but {got} is chosen. Pick the matching pair.
sameVersion: This is the version the module already runs. No need to update unless you are testing.
